name: Be Dino 🦖 - Jurassic Dinosaur Simulation
desc:
🦖 BE DINO 🦖 

🦕 Become your favorite dinosaur
🍖 Eat prey and grow stronger
🌋 Unlock rare and powerful dinos
💎 Collect all the unique species
👑 Climb the ranks and be the Apex Predator!

👍 Like the game and join the group ⭐
💻 New codes are posted in the group!

🗣️ In Be Dino, it's eat or be eaten. A thrilling PvP survival of the fittest - fight to become the apex dinosaur! Hunt for food, grow stronger, and collect new dinos in a fun prehistoric arena. Evolve from cool raptor to epic trex. Unlock rare species, steal food from other dinos, and rule the jurassic jungle.
